newsitem.title: PERU: Peruvian guerrillas kill two road workers.
newsitem.headline: Peruvian guerrillas kill two road workers.

text.p: Peruvian guerrillas suspected to belong to the Maoist group Shining Path killed two government road maintenance workers in the highland province of Ayacucho on Monday, police said.

A police spokesman in Ayacucho, which is a stronghold of the Shining Path, said a group of about 20 gunmen attacked the two Transport Ministry workers as they were clearing a highway of rocks and stones with a tractor near the town of Jarapa.

He told Reuters that the driver and passengers of a long- distance bus who witnessed the incident said the gunmen ordered the two men out of their tractor and shot them, blew up the tractor with dynamite and shouted Shining Path slogans.
"The driver and passengers said the suspected terrorists were carrying rifles and dynamite and shouting slogans of their group," said the policeman.
About 30,000 Peruvians have died in nearly 17 years of guerrilla violenced unleashed by the Shining Path and the smaller Marxist Tupac Amaru Revoltionary Movement (MRTA).
